# Devil Union

---

v1.3.0 brings the **devils of the underworld** into the world. A devil cannot walk here without a body, so it borrows one - and the deeper its **union** with its host, the more of the devil shows. Beat a host at full union and its devil may offer **you** a pact.

## The devils

| Devil | Rank and vice | Its magic | Boon (always, while bound) | Price (always, while bound) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Vharog**, the Cinder Maw | Mid-rank, Wrath | Cinder Fang, Wrath Pillars, Hellmouth | +10% melee damage | -10% mana regeneration |
| **Sileth**, the Pale Choir | Mid-rank, Sorrow | Grave Frost, Mourning Bell, The Pale Choir | spells hurt you 8% less | -8% melee damage |
| **Morvane**, the Hollow Crown | Mid-rank, Pride | Crown's Weight, Hollow Pull, Abyssal Throne | blows hurt you 8% less | spells recharge 10% slower |
| **Ghorza**, the Red Hunger | Mid-rank, Hunger | Red Hunger, Feeding Frenzy, Crimson Feast | your blows heal you a little | -20 max mana |
| **Vaelgrim**, the Crowned Abyss | Higher-rank, Dominion | Abyss Lance, Dominion, The Crowned Abyss | +12% spell power | loot rolls a little worse |

Vaelgrim is a **higher-rank** devil: it rules the others, and only the Crowned Vessel carries it. The lesser devils that seize knights make no pacts.

## Devil hosts

* **Where they walk:** the Forsaken Realm and the Marches at night; Devil-Scarred regions (day and night); the Spade Marches, where they march with Spade patrols (Spade hosts are mostly Morvane's). A host comes with a cultist or an imp or two. On a night of **The Underworld Stirs** there are far more.
* **Union:** a host starts at 0% - a mage in a tattered coat with its devil's eyes. Below **60% health** its devil digs in: **50% union** - horns, a devil's arm and glowing marks; it heals 20% and grows stronger. Below **30%** it reaches **full union** - wings and a tail, faster, tougher, flying at its prey and casting its devil's greatest spell. Its name shows its union.
* **Spoils:** only a host beaten **at full union** leaves its devil behind - a **Pact Sigil** (30%, and never more than 4 full-union hosts in a row without one) and a **Host Horn** (60%). Hosts beaten sooner leave only coin and the odd Devil Heart.
* Defeating 20 earns **Host Hunter**; the mission *Cast out the devils* asks for three.

## Possession

At night a **lesser devil** may seize a Magic Knight near you - or a lone knight walks up and is taken in front of you. The knight becomes a possessed host. **Beat it below 35% health** and the devil is driven out: the knight stands up free (and thanks you), and the devil flees as an imp. But **a blow that kills the host kills the knight too.** A possessed knight never goes past 50% union. Freeing three earns **Exorcist**.

## A pact of your own

* **The offer:** use a Pact Sigil to hear its devil - its rank, its vice, its magic, its **boon** and its **price**. Accept and you are bound; refuse and it waits. You hold one pact at a time: a new devil's pact breaks the old one (your bond starts again).
* **The union gauge** fills as you fight: 0.6 for every point of damage you deal, 1.2 for every point you take, 6 for a kill and 14 for a devil (imps, hosts, the Devil Host). It fills half as fast while you are joined, and 50% faster on a night of **The Underworld Stirs**.
* **50% union:** with the gauge at 50% use the sigil to join. Horns break through; your spells hit x1.25, your blows x1.35, and blows hurt you 10% less. The devil's first two moves are yours: **use** the sigil to cast, **sneak-use** to switch. They cost union, not mana.
* **100% union:** with a full gauge and **bond 3** you join fully - or a 50% union deepens by itself when you fill the gauge in battle. Wings: you glide and leap; spells x1.6, blows x1.7, blows and spells hurt you 20% less, mana flows x1.5, and the devil's third and greatest move is open.
* **The gauge drains** while you are joined (1.0% a second at 50%, 2.2% at 100%); when it runs dry the union fades.
* **Bond** grows with every second joined and every kill made joined (levels at 0, 150, 450, 1000, 1800 points). Each level adds 8% to the devil's moves.

## The devil's hold

While you are joined, your devil pushes to take over: its **hold** rises 1.0% a second at 50% and 3.2% at 100% (a higher-rank devil 1.4x as fast), and a little more each time you cast its moves. Your **Will** (from the Abyssal Seas) and your **bond** push back; at **bond 5** it never fights you at 50% (**Devil's Equal**). Apart, its hold fades.

If its hold fills, the devil **takes over** for 10 seconds: you cannot cast its moves, and it lashes out at anything near you - foes with its magic, **friends and companions** with its claws. Then it lets go and leaves you **empty and weak**.

A **Binding Chain** (craft: chain, Host Horn, chain - makes two; or buy one from the merchant) breaks its hold, ends a takeover, and keeps it quiet for 2 minutes.

## The Crowned Vessel

A captain of Magic Knights who gave his body to **Vaelgrim, the Crowned Abyss**. It waits in **Underworld Breaches** - scorched rifts in the dangerous lands (3 stars and up, most of all Devil-Scarred regions) - and steps out of the rift as you come near. Or raise an **Abyssal Crown** (craft: Host Horns, gold, Devil Hearts and crying obsidian) at night and it answers.

* **0%:** a crowned knight with a black greatsword - slashes, blinks behind you, Abyss Lances and Dominion (watch for the warning circle).
* **50% union** (half its health): great horns break through the crown and both arms turn; it calls lesser devils in borrowed bodies and drags you in.
* **Full union** (a quarter left): wings, a tail and a burning halo - and **The Crowned Abyss**, the underworld falling on you, three times.

Beat it for **Vaelgrim's own Pact Sigil** (**Crown-Breaker**). Its breach's chest holds Devil Hearts, Host Horns, Binding Chains and rolled treasure.
